packagePolicy: Original footprint, then adjacent smaller, then adjacent larger in imported standard packages
heightPolicy: Substitutes must meet maximum height; known excess height may only appear in a separate reference group
tierBasis: Adjacent distinct values in unblocked imported records; never skip a tier to find a match
temperaturePolicy: EIA Class 2 only; higher upper temperature, no narrower lower range, no wider drift; nearest compatible upper temperature in imported records
